body.text: You gave {param:town} your word, {param:months_ago} months ago, and it was not kept.
I told the people it would come. They planned on it. I have had to stand in the hall since and explain why it did not, and I found I could not, because I did not know.
I should like to know. I should like, more than that, not to have to ask.

options.text: and have read it with care
and would rather not have needed it

options.label: apologise, and mean it
options.text: It was not kept, and that is on me and not on you. I am sorry for it, and for the hall.
